note: Fixed task set for the v1.1.0 A/B context benchmark. Prompts are identical for both groups; only the language of the skill documentation differs. Do not edit after results are recorded.

tasks.prompt: 在 H:\work\部署 目录下新建 deploy.ps1，里面输出中文提示「开始部署」，并在最后打印完成状态。要求这个脚本在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上直接双击也能正确显示中文。
tasks.expected_behavior: Writes the file as UTF-8 with BOM, uses explicit encoding on all I/O, does not rely on the profile.
required_checks: file starts with EF BB BF
no non-ASCII written through > or Out-File

tasks.prompt: 同事发来一个 build.ps1，UTF-8 无 BOM，里面的中文日志全变成「涓」这类乱码。给我最小改动的修复方案，不要改变脚本逻辑。
tasks.expected_behavior: Diagnoses link 1 (BOM-less parsed as ANSI), prescribes re-saving as UTF-8 with BOM or explicit -Encoding UTF8 on read.

tasks.prompt: 用 .NET 方法把一个字符串写成 UTF-8 带 BOM 的文件，写到 H:\work\app.log，写完要能确认字节正确。给出完整可运行代码。
tasks.expected_behavior: Uses System.IO.File::WriteAllText with a UTF8Encoding($true) instance and reads back for verification.
forbidden_actions: using Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 as the answer

tasks.prompt: 现有脚本用 $data | Out-File report.txt 写报表，下游 Python 读出来报 UnicodeDecodeError。怎么改才能让下游正常读，同时尽量少动代码？
tasks.expected_behavior: Explains link 2 (UTF-16LE + BOM), replaces Out-File with WriteAllText and the no-BOM UTF8Encoding.
forbidden_actions: telling the downstream to decode UTF-16 as the only fix

tasks.prompt: 只在 PowerShell 7.4 上运行的脚本，要写一个 UTF-8 无 BOM 的文件，并且保证输出重定向到文件时不带颜色控制字符。给我写法。
tasks.expected_behavior: Uses explicit UTF8Encoding($false), sets $PSStyle.OutputRendering = 'PlainText'.
required_checks: notes that -Encoding UTF8 differs across versions
forbidden_actions: assuming the default is enough without stating it

tasks.prompt: 在 PowerShell 7 里调用 git.exe，提交信息带中文和引号，传过去变成问号或者被拆开。怎么传才稳。
tasks.expected_behavior: Checks $PSNativeCommandArgumentPassing, advises Standard and file-based transport, explains argv is Unicode.

tasks.prompt: 同一段代码在 5.1 上写出的文件是 UTF-8，在 7 上却是别的样子，怀疑是编码问题。给我一个能同时看清两边实际字节的排查步骤。
tasks.expected_behavior: Explains Set-Content/-Encoding UTF8 divergence, prescribes byte-level inspection on both hosts.

tasks.prompt: 写一个工具脚本，要同时能在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 和 PowerShell 7 上跑，需要读文件前 4 个字节判断 BOM。给出双版本都能解析的写法。
tasks.expected_behavior: Avoids -AsByteStream on the common path, branches on PSEdition, or uses .NET byte reading.
required_checks: no 7-only syntax on the common path

tasks.prompt: 审一下这段双版本脚本，指出哪些写法会让 5.1 直接解析失败：用了 $a ?? $b、ForEach-Object -Parallel、还有 Join-Path $a 'b' 'c'。
tasks.expected_behavior: Classifies each as parse error vs missing parameter vs missing command, with replacements.
required_checks: distinguishes parse error from runtime error

tasks.prompt: 双版本脚本里要读 GBK 编码的配置文件，5.1 和 7 上都能正确读到中文。给出方案。
tasks.expected_behavior: Uses an explicit code page encoding on both, notes 7 turns invalid bytes into U+FFFD silently.
required_checks: notes the U+FFFD failure mode on 7

tasks.prompt: 写一个 .bat，cd 到 H:\工作\发布 然后调用里面的 build.exe。要求中文路径能被识别。
tasks.expected_behavior: Saves as GBK without BOM, uses chcp 936, keeps the skeleton ASCII.
forbidden_actions: relying on echo as a test

tasks.prompt: 一个必须存成 UTF-8 的 .bat，运行时中文路径 if exist 找不到。怎么让它同时满足「UTF-8 存储」和「路径识别」。
tasks.expected_behavior: chcp 65001 on line 1, no BOM, states the caveats of the 65001 path.

tasks.prompt: .bat 里调用外部程序并传一个含中文和空格的参数，参数传丢了一半。给出可靠写法并说明为什么。
tasks.expected_behavior: Passes via a file or a PowerShell shim, explains the byte layer and code page.
forbidden_actions: nested quote escaping as the only fix

tasks.prompt: 写一段 Python，在 H:\work 下写一个含中文的 data.txt，再读回来打印。要求双击运行和从 agent 里运行结果一致。
tasks.expected_behavior: Every open() carries encoding='utf-8'; stdout handled explicitly.
required_checks: explicit encoding on read and write

tasks.prompt: 一个 .py 文件第一行写的是 # coding: gbk，文件本身是 GBK 编码，Python 能跑。现在要转成 UTF-8，要注意什么？
tasks.expected_behavior: Rewrites bytes and declaration together, warns about BOM conflicts, keeps behaviour verified.

tasks.prompt: Python 报 SyntaxError: 'gb2312' codec can't decode byte 0x81 in position ...，文件声明是 gb2312，内容其实是 GBK 扩展字符。怎么定位和修。
tasks.expected_behavior: Explains GB2312 is a subset of GBK with holes, prescribes GBK/GB18030 or rewriting the character.
forbidden_actions: declaring the file corrupt without diagnosis

tasks.prompt: Python 调 subprocess 执行一个中文路径下的 exe，拿到输出是乱码；同时 Python 又把一段中文交给 PowerShell 处理。两边怎么交接才不出错。
tasks.expected_behavior: Uses argv lists, explicit encoding on subprocess, files or run_ps.py for the reverse direction.
forbidden_actions: guessing the code page from the mojibake

tasks.prompt: 用 Git Bash 批量处理一批中文文件名的脚本，中途要调用 python.exe 和 powershell.exe。路径和编码怎么处理才不会两边都不认。
tasks.expected_behavior: Explains MSYS path conversion, when to set MSYS_NO_PATHCONV, and the clean UTF-8 chain inside Bash.
forbidden_actions: hard-coding H:/ paths inside Bash-only tools

tasks.prompt: 在 agent 里执行一段含中文参数的 PowerShell 脚本，要求脚本能拿到真实的 $PSScriptRoot，并且不能悄悄放宽执行策略。给出命令。
tasks.expected_behavior: Uses run_ps.py --invoke-file, states that no -ExecutionPolicy is injected by default.

tasks.prompt: 帮我检查 H:\work 下所有 .ps1 的编码是否适合 5.1，列出有问题的文件。检查过程不能改任何系统设置，也不能改这些文件。
tasks.expected_behavior: Uses the read-only detector in a loop, reports structured fields, changes nothing.
